benchmark.name: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index
benchmark.score_representation: underlying_public_source_numbers; display rounding only; numerical precision is not statistical certainty
benchmark.cost_basis: AA weighted task costs calculated from observed benchmark token use and published provider token prices, not an OpenRouter invoice estimate.
benchmark.cost_source_updated_at_note: AA retrieval time is recorded; AA does not publish a per-row update timestamp.
benchmark.evaluation_run_date_note: October 7 is the source verification date; AA does not expose a per-configuration evaluation completion date.

selection_policy.objective: Minimum observed measured benchmark task cost for a minimum score; maximum observed score at or below a benchmark task cost budget.
selection_policy.use_case_limits: A broad composite; benchmark points are not equal units of practical utility. Workload, context, tool support, review cost and reliability can change the best choice.
selection_policy.free_routes: Verified first-party free configuration exposed separately, requires allow_limited_free:true. Default frontier excludes limited free routes. Neither token discounts nor free aliases overwrite measured AA costs.
selection_policy.price_basis: Both queries use AA benchmark-task cost; these are not dollar caps on a production prompt.

reasoning_control.note: Opened official Responses docs state none disables thinking and every other effort enables identical thinking. OpenRouter reasoning.enabled=true enables this native on state; named efforts are not distinct intensities.

floor.rationale: High-capability default candidate: upgrading Sol low to MiMo Pro adds 4.240645 points for $0.002471/task (+1.89%). The next upgrade, Sol medium, adds 1.459121 points for $0.080478 (+60.41%): $0.055155 per point, 94.64x the preceding marginal cost. MiMo Pro costs 37.66% less than Sol medium while delivering 1.459121 fewer index points. Validate coding reliability, latency, locale and tools on the application workload.
floor.confidence: workload_conditional_frontier_heuristic; intervals not equal practical utility

ceiling.rationale: Optional higher-capability ceiling before Sol max: xhigh to max adds 0.795492 points for $0.331306 (+84.33%), or $0.416479/point, 4.5197x the preceding marginal rate. Higher-priced Opus can still be worthwhile when failures or human review cost more than model calls.
ceiling.confidence: workload_conditional_frontier_heuristic; intervals not equal practical utility

caveats: Task costs are benchmark averages and do not predict the bill for an individual prompt.
No paid generation calls were made; catalog presence and supported efforts were verified.
Canonical slugs identify catalog revisions; request.model uses the verified callable id, not canonical_slug or a latest alias.
Claude results include adaptive reasoning and default safety fallback; provider routing fallback is a separate setting.
Sonnet prerelease structured-output bug reruns remain unconfirmed; latest tables are used for comparisons.
Routing is restricted to the model's first-party provider with required parameters; callers may choose broader routing after checking costs and support.
Required tool/vision/output parameters must be checked separately for the user's workload.
AA marks SciCode and CritPt under review; rounding and evaluation uncertainty can move small score gaps.
OpenRouter lists high as Opus 5.5 default; Anthropic documents medium. Every actionable row sets effort explicitly.
Gemini 3.8 Flash introductory token pricing lasts through December 31, 2026; it remains cost-dominated at current published AA task costs.
OpenAI fixed Sol/Luna image encoding September 25. AA does not expose per-row completion dates, so post-fix rerun status is not inferred.
Archived launch articles can quote superseded numbers: the September 22 Sol article says $1.06; the current v4.3.2 model page says $1.04. Current model pages control.
Search snippets can show stale or different-version values (e.g. Luna low 21); live English v4.3.2 pages show 22 and control.
OpenAI reasoning configurations use the OpenRouter Responses endpoint for tool calling. Add input rather than messages; OpenRouter Responses is stateless.
No universal optimal floor is established without a workload, success target and budget; cheaper Luna options remain appropriate for easy tasks.

No new retirement of an actionable model was found. Gemini 2.5 has restricted legacy access and is not included; its OpenRouter expiration metadata and Google service policy should not be treated as interchangeable.
All-lab discovery is broader than complete comparable measurement coverage. Coverage inventory includes pending/unmatched entries.
The earlier same-day report used rounded comparisons. Precise boundaries now use underlying public embedded AA values; close score differences are not statistically established advantages.
Subscription model labels, clients, tools and multi-agent modes are not a measured apples-to-apples API benchmark harness.
MiMo release-date discrepancy: official launch/update September 22 vs AA/OpenRouter September 21; canonical revision remains 20260921.

Haiku 5.5 launch-day results are independent AA measurements, not vendor benchmark claims; exact evaluation completion dates and speed measurements are unavailable. SciCode/CritPt remain under review. AA Default Fallback labels are reconciled with official docs: Haiku has no server-side fallback and default leaves refusals unchanged. No paid generation test was run.

October 7 Anthropic launch also announces lower Sonnet 5.5 cache-read pricing ($0.10 per million short-context tokens), while the checked OpenRouter catalog still lists $0.20. Existing AA task costs were not recalculated from token prices or replaced with vendor typical-agentic savings claims; wait for AA revised task costs.
